### Yield

```{r}
if (!is.null(yield_data)) {
  plot_obs_pred(yield_data, color = ~model, colors = cols,
    ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(yield_data, "Yield"))
} else plotly::plot_ly()
```

### Numbers-at-age

```{r}
plot_age_year(catch_data, plot = plot_obs_pred, frame = ~age, color = ~model,
  colors = cols, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(catch_data, "Catch"))
```

### F-at-age

```{r}
if (!is.null(F_data) && nrow(F_data)) {
  d <- mortality_plot_data(F_data, mean_data, fits, "F")
  plot_age_year(d, plot = plot_mortality, frame = ~age, color = ~model,
    legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "F (per year)")
} else plotly::plot_ly()
```
